biggest_catch: The referrer does NOT get $200 per referral. Referrer rewards are milestone-based: your first referral earns $50 in stock; you earn nothing for referrals 2, 4-9, etc. until the next milestone. The $200 figure is the friend's sign-up bonus ceiling, not the referrer's.
catches: Referrer earns only at milestones: $50 at 1 referral, $150 at 3, $800 at 10, $4,000 at 50, $10,000 at 200 — no bonus for referrals between milestones.
Reward is stock (whole/fractional shares from a fixed list of 26 large-cap companies), not cash; cannot sell for 3 trading days; cash value cannot be withdrawn for 60 days after claiming.

Friend's signup must begin on or after September 1, 2026 at 9 AM PT to count under the current offer; friend must open an individual brokerage account and fund it with a deposit greater than $0 (merely linking a bank account does not count).
You and your friend must be US residents; you must have an active individual brokerage account in good standing; 60 days to claim each milestone reward before it expires.
$15,000 annual cap on bonus stock rewards; Robinhood can modify or terminate the offer at any time without notice.
Rewards reported for tax purposes (1099) and subject to capital gains treatment on sale.

steps: In the Robinhood app, go to Account (person icon) > Menu (3 bars) > Rewards to get your referral link or QR code: https://robinhood.com/us/en/support/articles/invite-friends-get-free-stock/?region=US
Send your link to a friend who has never had a Robinhood account — they must be a US resident.
Your friend opens an individual taxable brokerage account and funds it with a settled deposit greater than $0 (linking a bank alone does not count).
Track progress in the app under Rewards > clock icon; your first milestone ($50 in stock) triggers after the friend's deposit settles.
Claim the milestone reward within 60 days in the app, then pick whole/fractional shares from the 26-company list.
Wait 3 trading days to sell the stock; keep the cash value in the account 60 days before withdrawing.
timing: Milestone bonus credited approximately one week after claiming; stock sellable 3 trading days after grant; cash value withdrawable 60 days after claiming.
